archetype: Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury) with a Vintage Journal + Sci-Fi Terminal hybrid aesthetic.

typography.instructions: Use @expo-google-fonts/cormorant-garamond for headings and @expo-google-fonts/space-mono for data/terminal elements to create the 'vintage meets tech' vibe.

EraCard.container: borderRadius: 12, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: border_subtle, overflow: hidden, backgroundColor: surface_card
EraCard.overlay: Absolute positioned LinearGradient (transparent to #110e0a at bottom) to ensure text readability.
EraCard.danger_meter: Small pill with icon, colored based on 1-9 level (1-3 Green, 4-6 Yellow, 7-9 Red).
EraCard.lock_state: Absolute centered blur view with lock icon for premium eras. Image is heavily darkened.

ItemPickerCard.container: Square aspect ratio, borderRadius: 8, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: border_subtle, backgroundColor: surface_card, padding: md, alignItems: center, justifyContent: center
ItemPickerCard.selected_state: borderColor: primary_brand, backgroundColor: rgba(200, 149, 58, 0.1), shadowColor: primary_brand, shadowRadius: 8

ActionInput.container: minHeight: 150, backgroundColor: surface_card, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: border_subtle, borderRadius: 8, padding: md
ActionInput.character_counter: Absolute bottom right, color: text_secondary, fontFamily: body

VerdictBadge.container: paddingVertical: 8, paddingHorizontal: 16, borderRadius: 20, borderWidth: 2, alignItems: center
VerdictBadge.dynamic_styling: Border and Text color mapped to verdict_states. Shadow/Glow effect matching the color.

PrimaryButton.container: backgroundColor: transparent, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: primary_brand, borderRadius: 8, paddingVertical: 16, alignItems: center
PrimaryButton.text: color: primary_brand, fontFamily: body_bold, fontSize: 16, textTransform: uppercase, letterSpacing: 2

animations.loading_state: withRepeat(withSequence(withTiming(0.4), withTiming(1)), -1, true) for glowing text 'The Time Judge Deliberates...'
animations.verdict_reveal: ZoomIn.duration(800).springify() for Badge; Animated Number for Score ticking from 0 to final score.

Home_EraSelector.layout: Vertical ScrollView. Top header with app title. Grid or horizontal list of EraCards. Section for 'Free Eras' and 'Premium Eras'.
Home_EraSelector.background: ImageBackground with bg_leather texture, very dark overlay.

ItemPicker.layout: Vertical layout. Top: Era Image + Title + Scenario Teaser. Middle: 4x2 Grid of ItemPickerCards. Bottom: PrimaryButton 'Enter Time Stream'.

ActionInput.layout: KeyboardAvoidingView. Top: Selected Item summary. Middle: Large multiline TextInput with counter. Bottom: Submit Button.

VerdictScreen.layout: Centered dramatic reveal. Top: Animated VerdictBadge. Middle: Large ticking Score (e.g. 85/100). Text block for 'Time Judge Narrative' and 'Historical Twist'. Bottom: Stack of 'Play Again' and 'View Logs' buttons.
VerdictScreen.background: ImageBackground of the Era, heavily blurred and darkened.

HistoryStats.layout: Vertical ScrollView. Top: Bento box stats (Games Played, Survival Rate, Highest Score). Bottom: List of past attempts. Each row shows Era, Date, Score, and a left border color-coded by verdict.

media.instructions: Use these Unsplash URLs for the Era cards and Backgrounds. Do NOT use placeholders.

testing_requirements.instructions: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' (or 'testID' in React Native) attribute. E.g., testID='era-card-roman', testID='item-picker-submit'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize React Native Expo app with reanimated and vector-icons.
Implement the provided color palette in a theme configuration or stylesheet object.
Load Cormorant Garamond and Space Mono via @expo-google-fonts.
Use testID properties extensively across all Touchables, Inputs, and crucial text displays.
Follow the Archetype 5 design rules: focus on contrast, dark mode dominance, and high-end texture. No neon out of place, rely on the gold/amber colors.
Use 'react-native-reanimated' for the verdict reveal and score ticking.
